newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BPSM hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BPSM hits all-time high.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese bank Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM), which have risen sharply recently after a surge in its first-half profits, hit an all-time high of 2,510 escudos, dealers said.
"People were saying in the market that a high for Sotto in the short term was 2,500 escudos, but now it has broken through that level, anything can happen," a dealer said.
Last week Banco Sotto reported a 194 percent rise in first-half profit to 8.4 billion escudos.
Banco Sotto later hit a new high of 2,525 escudos, up 226, in volume of 675,914 shares at 1508 GMT.
